summary: VEHIQ Iter7 Phase B testing complete. BACKEND: 68/68 PASS (31 NEW iter7b + 37 iter7 Phase A regression). New tests cover: photo upload R2 503-when-not-configured semantics for both services & events (R2 not configured in env, returns 503 as expected; non-owner gets 403; unknown service id returns 404); service reviews lifecycle including UPSERT (same user re-rates updates not duplicates), recommended threshold logic (count>=3 AND avg>=4.5), and dropping recommended back to false when 4th rating drags avg<4.5; my-review returns {} when none and returns doc with rating after post; cross-user delete forbidden + own delete recomputes aggregates; event comments CRUD with pagination (items/total/page/limit), validation (1-2000 chars enforced via 422), own-edit OK, cross-user PUT/DELETE 403, owner DELETE OK; AI suggested_services keyword detection with seeded BMW detailing service in Warszawa successfully matched via PL prompt 'Mam BMW w Warszawie potrzebuję polerowanie lakieru' returning seeded service in suggested_services list (also verified empty list when no intent+city detected). Phase A regression all 37 tests still PASS. FRONTEND smoke: /services list page has data-testid services-view-list + services-view-map toggle buttons (Lista/Mapa) rendering correctly, services list shows 5.0 rating + (1) count for FazaB Test Warsztat. /services/:slug renders review section with all 5 stars data-testid review-star-1..5 + map-view container. /events/:slug renders comments section + comment input + map-view container. Event 'Zlot BMW Warszawa' displays correctly. Polish-first i18n verified across pages.

ui_bugs.issue: After clicking [data-testid="services-view-map"] toggle, [data-testid="map-view"] container was not detected within 2s in headless. Map view container DID render correctly on /services/:slug and /events/:slug detail pages so MapView component itself is fine — likely the toggle on the list page either renders the testid lazily after Leaflet asset load or uses a different wrapper. Re-check with longer wait or by inspecting the toggled DOM.

On /search?category=services, [data-testid="services-view-list"] and [data-testid="services-view-map"] were NOT detected even though spec says toggles should appear when category in (all,services,events). May be a missing render branch in /pages/Search.js for the category=services pre-filter URL state.

action_items: Verify /services list page MapView renders [data-testid="map-view"] after toggle click (may need to wait for leaflet tiles or check if conditional render hides it). Detail pages render it fine — only the list page toggle shows the gap.
Add [data-testid="services-view-list"] / services-view-map (and events equivalents) to /pages/Search.js when category in (all, services, events) — currently not rendered on /search?category=services.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/services.py upload_service_photos: order of checks is good (404 for missing service before 503 storage check; 403 owner check; 400 max-files; size+format; per-file failures captured). MAX_PHOTOS_PER_SERVICE=5 enforced via len(existing)+len(files) which is correct.
routers/services.py _recompute_rating uses round(...,2) and recommended=count>=3 AND avg>=4.5 — matches spec exactly. Aggregates persisted on service doc atomically.

routers/services.py add_review UPSERT logic: existing-doc check is correct — keeps id stable on re-rate. user_name/user_avatar populated only on first insert; if user later changes name, review still shows old name. Minor enhancement: refresh user_name on update path too.
routers/events.py CommentIn validation Field(min_length=1, max_length=2000) returns 422 — matches spec.

routers/ai_mechanic.py _detect_intent_and_city: brand handling has dead code path — `if brand and brand.lower() not in t: brand = vehicle.get('make')` is a no-op (brand is already vehicle make). Logic still works (brand is always passed to _suggest_services as vehicle's make, used as preference filter).
routers/ai_mechanic.py _suggest_services: when brand-prefer query returns no rows, falls back to non-brand query — good. Returns [] only when neither intent nor city detected — matches spec.
Frontend MapView verification: detail pages (/services/:slug, /events/:slug) render [data-testid="map-view"] correctly. Investigate why list page conditional render may skip it.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (detail pages OK; /services list-page map toggle + /search toggles need verification)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase B endpoints all verified at API level: POST/DELETE /api/services/{id}/photos (503 expected — R2 unconfigured), POST/DELETE /api/events/{id}/photos, GET/POST/DELETE /api/services/{id}/reviews + /my-review, GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/events/{id}/comments, POST /api/ai/ask (returns suggested_services). Recommended threshold logic verified: 3rd 5-star sets recommended=true; 4th 1-star drops avg to 4.0 -> recommended back to false. AI keyword detection works for PL inputs: 'BMW w Warszawie polerowanie lakieru' -> matches a Warszawa detailing service with brands=['BMW']. Frontend gaps to retest after main-agent fix: /services list MapView container, /search toggles for services/events categories. R2 storage NEVER configured in current env — actual upload path was not exercised; if main agent enables R2 later, re-run tests to confirm uploaded[] payload shape with id/url/thumb_url/is_main fields.
rca of the issue: Two minor frontend gaps. (1) Services list page Map toggle: clicking [data-testid="services-view-map"] did not produce the [data-testid="map-view"] selector within 2s. Likely either (a) MapView only mounts when service array is non-empty AND conditional render uses a different wrapper, or (b) async leaflet css/js load delays the testid. Suggest verifying /pages/Services.js renders <MapView data-testid="map-view"> always when mapView=true. (2) /search page Map/List toggle: spec says toggles render when category in (all,services,events) — verify Search.js renderToggle() branch covers ?category=services URL initial state.
